name: VinuChain
description: VinuChain core protocol contracts — Special Fee Contract (SFC) for validator staking, NodeDriver/NodeDriverAuth governance, and Quota/Payback contracts backing fee refunds

contracts.name: SFC
contracts.description: Special Fee Contract — manages validator creation, stake delegation, epoch rewards, lockups, and slashing

contracts.name: NodeDriverAuth
contracts.description: Owner-controlled governance contract for network administration — queues and executes time-locked migrations, network rule updates, epoch advances, and nonce increments

contracts.name: NodeDriver
contracts.description: EVM-facing relay contract between NodeDriverAuth and the EvmWriter precompile — emits canonical events for validator weight/pubkey changes, network rule updates, and epoch advances

contracts.name: OptimizedTransparentUpgradeableProxy
contracts.description: Legacy testnet Quota/Payback EIP-1967 proxy kept for historical transactions. PaybackV2 switched active quota accounting to the non-proxy QuotaContractV2 entry on 2026-05-16.

contracts.name: QuotaContract
contracts.description: Historical verified pre-PaybackV2 Quota/Payback implementation behind the legacy testnet proxy. Active testnet payback now uses QuotaContractV2.

contracts.name: QuotaContractV2
contracts.description: Active testnet PaybackV2 non-proxy contract. stakeFor(address) credits receiver refunds; funding wallet owns/withdraws stake via unstakeFor(address,uint256). Deployed 2026-05-16.

contracts.name: QuotaContractV2
contracts.description: Mainnet PaybackV2 non-proxy contract, deployed 2026-08-21. Replaces the Quota proxy 0x1c4269fb...0acda6 (ProxyAdmin key lost). Params mirror V1. Load-bearing only after the ELEMONT seal rebinds.

related_registries.name: VinuChain Name Service
related_registries.summary: ENS v1.7.0 port for the .vinu TLD. Live on testnet only; mainnet rollout is gated on Root.lock(vinu), owner-key split, mainnet deployment, and explorer multi-chain support. See ../vns/deployment-testnet.json for active addresses.
